look: Chalk geometry: a dark maths-explainer look (3Blue1Brown-style): clean vector dots, arrows and grids drawn in glowing strokes on a dark ground, shapes morphing smoothly, short serif captions

scenes.name: IER
scenes.desc: Title over a patch of dots whose triangles light up.

scenes.name: A different idea
scenes.desc: Poisson builds a new surface; IER joins our own dots into triangles.

scenes.name: Candidates
scenes.desc: One dot, its nearest neighbours, and the tangled fan of candidate triangles.

scenes.name: The trap
scenes.desc: An arm close to the chest: a fake link across the gap is shorter than the real ones.

scenes.name: Ruler and ant
scenes.desc: Straight distance versus walking distance along the surface, for two pairs of dots.

scenes.name: The ratio
scenes.desc: Walking over straight distance on a number line with the 1.3 cut-off.

scenes.name: Three labels
scenes.desc: Good, okay and bad candidates in three small panels.

scenes.name: The catch
scenes.desc: No surface to walk on, so a network must learn the labels from dots alone.
